title: Huhtanen and Perämäki (2015), Factoring Matrices into the Product of Circulant and Diagonal Matrices
inspection: Full author manuscript; Proposition 2.5, Theorem 2.10 and main factorization compared.

title: Boito and Eidelman (2025), Computation of quasiseparable representations of Green matrices
inspection: Primary abstract and publication metadata; inverse-band/Green context, not a complete theorem-by-theorem comparison.

title: Chandrasekaran, Epperly and Govindarajan, Graph-Induced Rank Structures and their Representations
inspection: Full text; Propositions 2.1–2.3 and cycle semiseparable discussion.

title: Strang (2010), Fast transforms: Banded matrices with banded inverses
inspection: Primary full-text search extract on nullity theorem; direct page intermittently blocked.

title: de Beaudrap and Gharibian (2016), A linear time algorithm for quantum 2-SAT
inspection: Full text; transfer matrices, cycle eigenvectors, singular constraints and algebraic complexity.

title: Arad, Santha, Sundaram and Zhang (2018), Linear-Time Algorithm for Quantum 2SAT
inspection: Full text; Proposition 2.3, Theorem 2.4, product constraints and algorithm.

title: Stacks Project, projective morphisms are proper
inspection: Theorem checked; standard algebraic-geometric ingredient, not original to this project.

title: Gurevich, Hadani and Howe, Quadratic reciprocity and the sign of the Gauss sum via the finite Weil representation
inspection: Primary text on odd-modulus Gauss sums and finite Weil representation.

title: Iwata, Fleischer and Fujishige, A combinatorial, strongly polynomial-time algorithm for minimizing submodular functions
inspection: Primary abstract; polynomial oracle-based optimization baseline.

title: Tao, An uncertainty principle for cyclic groups of prime order
inspection: Primary abstract/PDF and full-spark/support-sum statement.

title: Dvir and Liu (2019), Fourier and Circulant Matrices Are Not Rigid
inspection: Primary abstract and conference paper; comparison to unrestricted rigidity claims.

title: Guibas and Odlyzko (1981), String overlaps, pattern matching, and nontransitive games
inspection: Publisher abstract; classical forbidden-pattern counting framework.

title: Hauenstein and Sottile (2012), alphaCertified: certifying solutions to polynomial systems
inspection: Primary abstract; exact rational certification baseline, distinct from the project’s particular Banach box.

title: Massey (1969), Shift-register synthesis and BCH decoding
inspection: Original paper; shortest recurrence synthesis baseline.

title: Delvaux and Van Barel (2008), Rank-deficient submatrices of Fourier matrices
inspection: Official full 2006 preprint TW470; Lemma 8, Theorem 10, Sections 3–5. Final 2008 version not fully compared.

title: Bilyk, Lacey, Parissis and Vagharshakyan (2009), Exponential Squared Integrability for the Discrepancy Function in Two Dimensions
inspection: Primary paper pp.1–2 equation (1.2) verifies Schmidt’s classical logarithmic star-discrepancy theorem.

title: Schmidt (1972), Irregularities of distribution VII
inspection: Publisher record; original PDF access unsuccessful, theorem verified through P16.

title: Shukla, Kundu, Mitra and Grover (2023), On estimating parameters of a multi-component Chirp Model with equal chirp rates
inspection: Primary abstract; established common-chirp model, statistical rather than exact finite-field setting.

title: Yang, Ge and Wang (2025), Pursuing the Limit of Chirp Parameter Identifiability: A Computational Approach
inspection: Full primary model/identifiability formulation; continuous-parameter structured-rank approach.

title: Grigoriev, Singer and Karpinski (1990), Interpolation of sparse rational functions without knowing bounds on exponents
inspection: Original preprint, introduction and algebraic interpolation construction; general sparse rational interpolation is old.

title: Uteshev and Baravy (2016), Solution of Interpolation Problems via the Hankel Polynomial Construction
inspection: Full text; Theorems 2.2 and 6.2 distinguish classical Hankel/resultant interpolation from the new adjacent multiplicative pencils.

title: Pernet, Signargout and Villard (2023), Exact computations with quasiseparable matrices
inspection: Full primary paper; exact quasiseparable definition, representations and arithmetic costs.

title: Hwang, Lahoti, Dao and Gu (2024), Hydra: Bidirectional State Space Models Through Generalized Matrix Mixers
inspection: Primary paper/abstract; optional application context only, no transfer of project lower bounds to nonlinear networks.

title: Sturmfels (1994), On the Newton Polytope of the Resultant
inspection: Original paper, especially Theorems 2.1 and 4.1; extreme terms and initial-form resultants compared to the explicit diagonal-pencil valuation.

title: Nart (2014), Local computation of differents and discriminants
inspection: Original Section 3 and Definition 3.1; Newton-side resultant contributions and unequal slopes. Algorithm-specific finite-residue/local-field assumptions not transferred.

title: Osgood, Siripuram and Wu (2012), Discrete Sampling and Interpolation: Universal Sampling Sets for Discrete Bandlimited Spaces
inspection: Primary text, Theorems 4 and 9; balanced residue classes, universal sampling and one-vector support uncertainty, distinguished from all-endpoint cut-rank minimax.

title: Alexeev, Cahill and Mixon, Full Spark Frames
inspection: Primary text, Theorem 9; full-spark prime-power Fourier submatrices characterized by uniform residue distribution. Different invariant from the endpoint minimax.

title: Barnett (2022), How exponentially ill-conditioned are contiguous submatrices of the Fourier matrix?
inspection: Primary text; contiguous Fourier-block conditioning, distinguished from exact rank under independent arbitrary permutations.
